    		country_exists = RUK
       		RUK = { has_country_flag = ruk_united_solution }

		}

		}

			}

		}
	}

		}

			}

					has_idea = rks_newresistance_2
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_2
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = rks_newresistance_1
				}

			}
			
			if = {

					has_idea = rks_newresistance_victory
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_victory
			}

				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusveryweak

			}
			
			if = {

				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusweak
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {

				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusokay
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusgreat

				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusgreat
			}
			
			load_focus_tree = generic_focus

	title = rksplus.150.t
	desc = rksplus.150.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_sign_treaty2
	
	is_triggered_only = yes
	

	option = {
		name = rksplus.150.a
		
		trigger = { country_exists = RRO }

		RRO = {
			transfer_state = 955
			
			hidden_effect = {
		    add_state_core = 955

			}
		}
		
		GER = {
		    set_country_flag = GER_northern_dobruja_territorial_decision
		}

	}
	
	option = {
		name = rksplus.150.b
		
		trigger = { RBL = { controls_state = 77 } }
		
		RBL = {
			transfer_state = 955
			
			hidden_effect = {
		    add_state_core = 955

			}
		}
		
		GER = {
		    set_country_flag = GER_northern_dobruja_territorial_decision
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rksplus.156
	title = rksplus.156.t
	desc = rksplus.156.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_german_speech
	
	is_triggered_only = yes
	
	option = {
		name = rksplus.156.a

	}
	
	option = {
		name = rksplus.156.b
		
		trigger = { country_exists = RFG }

		RFG = {
		
		    swap_ideas = {
			    remove_idea = rksplus_germanrule
				add_idea = rksplus_germanrule_collab
			}
			    
		
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = rks_newresistance_3
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_3
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = rks_newresistance_2
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_2
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = rks_newresistance_1
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_1
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = rks_newresistance_victory
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_victory
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusveryweak
				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusveryweak
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusweak
				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusweak
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusokay
				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusokay
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusgreat
				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusgreat
			}
			
			load_focus_tree = generic_focus

		    set_cosmetic_tag = RFG_collaboration_afghanistan
			
			retire_character = RFG_Hans_von_Funck
			promote_character = RFG_FaqirOfIpi

			set_party_name = {
				ideology = fascism
				long_name = "ANU"
				name = "Afghan National Ummah"
			}
			
			set_country_flag = RFG_afghanistan_collaboration_flag
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rksplus.157
	title = rksplus.157.t
	desc = rksplus.157.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_german_speech
	
	is_triggered_only = yes
	
	option = {
		name = rksplus.157.a
		
		trigger = { 
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = GER_ostland_option2_flag
			} 
		}
		
		add_political_power = 25
		GER_improve_rosenbergs_trait_effect = yes
		add_stability = 0.01

		set_autonomy = { target = ROT autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat}

		every_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state = 935
					state = 95
					state = 204
					state = 206
					state = 96
					state = 936
					state = 207
					state = 784
					state = 814
					state = 11
					state = 815
					state = 189
					state = 190
					state = 809
					state = 808
					state = 810
					state = 12
					state = 811
					state = 13
					state = 812
					state = 813
					state = 191
				}
			}
			transfer_state_to = ROT
			add_claim_by = ROT
			add_compliance = 25
		}
		
		hidden_effect = {
			ROT = { add_state_core = 808 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = GER_southbelarus_ostland_territorial_decision
				}
				ROT = {
					transfer_state = 94
					transfer_state = 194
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = GER_gomel_ostland_territorial_decision
				}
				ROT = {
					transfer_state = 241
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = GER_LPN_ROT_territorial_decision
				}
				ROT = {
					transfer_state = 208
					transfer_state = 209
					transfer_state = 210
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = GER_petersburg_ROT_territorial_decision
				}
				ROT = {
					transfer_state = 195
				}
			}
		}

		set_country_flag = GER_ostland_option1_flag

	}
	
	option = {
		name = rksplus.157.b
		
		trigger = { 
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = GER_ostland_option1_flag
			}
		}
		
		GER_improve_rosenbergs_trait_effect = yes
		
		set_autonomy = { target = ROT autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat}

		ROT = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = ROT_baltic_nationalism
				}
				remove_ideas = ROT_baltic_nationalism
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = ROT_bolshevik_resistance
				}
				remove_ideas = ROT_bolshevik_resistance
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						GER = {  has_country_flag = GER_ostland_option2_firsttime_flag }
					}
				}
				add_ideas = rks_newresistance_3
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						GER = {  has_country_flag = GER_ostland_option2_firsttime_flag }
					}
				}
				add_ideas = RKP_armystatusveryweak
			}
			
			load_focus_tree = rksgeneric_tree

		    set_cosmetic_tag = ROT_whiterussia
			
			retire_character = ROT_Hinrich_Lohse
			promote_character = ROT_Curt_von_Gottberg

			set_party_name = {
				ideology = fascism
				long_name = "Nationalsozialistische Deutsche Arbeiterpartei - Weißruthenien"
				name = "NSDAP - Weißruthenien"
			}
			
			set_capital = { state = 206 }
			
			hidden_effect = {
				transfer_state = 935
				transfer_state = 95
				transfer_state = 204
				transfer_state = 96
				transfer_state = 936
				transfer_state = 206
				transfer_state = 207
			}
		}
		
		GER = {
			set_country_flag = ROT_whiterussia_flag
			set_country_flag = GER_ostland_option2_flag
			set_country_flag = GER_ostland_option2_firsttime_flag
		}
		
		RBT = {

			hidden_effect = {
				GER = { set_autonomy = { target = RBT autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat } }
				
				transfer_state = 814
				transfer_state = 11
				transfer_state = 815
				transfer_state = 189
				transfer_state = 190
				transfer_state = 809
				transfer_state = 808
				transfer_state = 810
				transfer_state = 12
				transfer_state = 811
				transfer_state = 13
				transfer_state = 812
				transfer_state = 813
				transfer_state = 191
				
				ROT = { add_state_core = 206 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						GER = { has_country_flag = GER_southbelarus_ostland_territorial_decision }
					}
					ROT = {
						transfer_state = 94
						transfer_state = 194
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						GER = { has_country_flag = GER_gomel_ostland_territorial_decision }
					}
					ROT = {
						transfer_state = 241
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						GER = { has_country_flag = GER_belarus_vilnius_territorial_decision }
					}
					ROT = {
						transfer_state = 784
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						GER = { has_country_flag = GER_baltic_vilnius_territorial_decision }
					}
					RBT = {
						transfer_state = 784
					}
				}
			}
		}

country_event = {
	id = rksplus.167
	title = rksplus.167.t
	desc = rksplus.167.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_german_speech
	
	is_triggered_only = yes
	
	option = {
		name = rksplus.167.a

	}
	
	option = {
		name = rksplus.167.b
		
		trigger = { country_exists = RDN }

		RDN = {
		
		    swap_ideas = {
			    remove_idea = rksplus_germanrule
				add_idea = rksplus_germanrule_collab
			}
			    
		
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = rks_newresistance_3
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_3
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = rks_newresistance_2
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_2
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = rks_newresistance_1
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_1
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = rks_newresistance_victory
				}
				remove_ideas = rks_newresistance_victory
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusveryweak
				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusveryweak
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusweak
				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusweak
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusokay
				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusokay
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_idea = RKP_armystatusgreat
				}
				remove_ideas = RKP_armystatusgreat
			}
			
			load_focus_tree = generic_focus

		    set_cosmetic_tag = RDN_collaboration_denmark
			
			retire_character = RDN_Leader
			promote_character = RDN_Fritz_Clausen

			set_party_name = {
				ideology = fascism
				long_name = "DNSAP"
				name = "National Socialist Workers' Party of Denmark"
			}
			
			set_country_flag = RDN_denmark_collaboration_flag
		}
	}
}

			hidden_effect = {
				add_state_core = 34
				add_state_core = 1095

			}
		}

		GER_improve_rosenbergs_trait_effect = yes

		GER = { set_autonomy = { target = RBG autonomy_state = autonomy_reichskommissariat } }
		
		GER = { set_country_flag = GER_rksplus_belgium_split }

	}
}

country_event = {
	id = rksunited.2

	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_rally
	
	is_triggered_only = yes
	

	option = {
		name = rksunited.2.a
		
		trigger = { 
		}
		
		RNF = {
			
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						REY = { controls_state = 911 controls_state = 995 }
					}
					911 = { add_core_of = RNF }
					995 = { add_core_of = RNF }
				}

				add_state_core = 552
				add_state_core = 452
				add_state_core = 447
				add_state_core = 907
				add_state_core = 457
				add_state_core = 456
				add_state_core = 458

				add_state_core = 290
				add_state_core = 783
			}

                target = REY
                transfer_troops = yes
            }

				every_unit_leader = {
					set_nationality = RNF
				}
			}
			annex_country = {
                target = RGL
                transfer_troops = yes
            }
			RGL = {
				every_unit_leader = {
					set_nationality = RNF
				}
			}
			
			set_cosmetic_tag = RNF_reichskommissariat_unitedrks

		name = rksunited.15.a
		
		trigger = { 
		}
		
		GER = { set_autonomy = { target = RBL autonomy_state = autonomy_reichsprotectorate } }
		
		RBL = {
			
			hidden_effect = {
			
			    if = {
					limit = {

					}

				}

					}

country_event = {
	id = rkspeacedeal.1
	title = rkspeacedeal.1.t
	desc = rkspeacedeal.1.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_soviet_tanks_snow
	
	trigger = {
		tag = SOV
		has_war_with = GER
		surrender_progress > 0.70
		has_civil_war = no

		NOT = {
			has_global_flag = rksplus_ussr_peace_disabled
		}
		
		OR = {
			GER = {

country_event = {
	id = rkspeacedeal.4
	title = rkspeacedeal.4.t
	desc = rkspeacedeal.4.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_soviet_tanks_snow
	
	trigger = {
		tag = SOV
		has_war_with = GER
		surrender_progress > 0.79
		has_civil_war = no

		has_global_flag = rksplus_ussr_peace_ural_option

		NOT = {
			has_global_flag = rksplus_ussr_peace_disabled
		}
		
		OR = {
			GER = {
				controls_state = 219
				controls_state = 217
				controls_state = 195
			}
			GER = {
				any_allied_country = {
					controls_state = 219
					controls_state = 217
					controls_state = 195
				}
			}
			GER = {
				controls_state = 217
				any_allied_country = {
					controls_state = 219
					controls_state = 195
				}
			}
			GER = {
				controls_state = 219
				any_allied_country = {
					controls_state = 217
					controls_state = 195
				}
			}
			GER = {
				controls_state = 195
				any_allied_country = {
					controls_state = 217
					controls_state = 219
				}
			}
			GER = {
				controls_state = 217
				controls_state = 219
				any_allied_country = {
					controls_state = 195
				}
			}
			GER = {
				controls_state = 219
				controls_state = 195
				any_allied_country = {
					controls_state = 217
				}
			}
			GER = {
				controls_state = 217
				controls_state = 195
				any_allied_country = {
					controls_state = 219
				}
			}
			AND = {
				GER = {
					any_allied_country = {
						controls_state = 219
						controls_state = 217
					}
				}
				FIN = {
					controls_state = 195
				}
			}
			AND = {
				GER = {
					controls_state = 219
					controls_state = 217
				}
				FIN = {
					controls_state = 195
				}
			}
			GER = {
				219  = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes }
				217  = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes }
				195  = { is_controlled_by_ROOT_or_subject = yes }
			}
		}
	} 

	mean_time_to_happen = { days = 30 }

	fire_only_once = yes
	
	option = {
		name = rkspeacedeal.4.a

		GER = {
			country_event = { id = rkspeacedeal.5 }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = rkspeacedeal.3.a_tt
		custom_effect_tooltip = rkspeacedeal.1.a_tt
		effect_tooltip = {
			GER = {
				add_stability = 0.05
				add_war_support = 0.05
				
				white_peace = {
					tag = SOV
				}
				
				#add_ideas = GER_eastern_chaos
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = rkspeacedeal.4.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}

		custom_effect_tooltip = rkspeacedeal.4.a_tt
		add_war_support = 0.01

		add_timed_idea = {
			idea = SOV_purification_desperation
			days = 90
		}
	}
